  1. jmt.common.exception

Uses of Package
jmt.common.exception

Packages that use jmt.common.exception
Package
Description
NetStrategies
Strategy interfaces and base classes used by the JSIM simulation engine to implement the behaviour of the network elements.
NetStrategies.ForkStrategies
Strategies used by fork stations to split a job into the output tasks that are then routed to the downstream stations.
NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies
Queue insertion strategies that select the position in the queue where an arriving job is placed, implementing queueing disciplines such as FCFS and priority-based placement.
NetStrategies.RoutingStrategies
Routing strategies used by router nodes to select the destination station of each departing job.
NetStrategies.ServiceStrategies
Service time strategies determining the service time of jobs at a station, including load independent and load dependent service distributions.
NetStrategies.VacationStrategies
Vacation strategies modelling servers that suspend their service for a vacation period, as supported by the extended JSIM simulation engine.
NodeSections
Node sections, the building blocks from which the JSIM simulation engine stations are composed.
QueueNet
Queueing network model of the JSIM simulation engine: nodes, stations, jobs, job classes, measures and the global structures that connect them.
analytical
Analytical JMVA model layer: constants, parameters and the model data structure of the alphanumeric MVA solver, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
jaba.link
Link component of the JABA graphical interface.
jmt.commandline
Command line interface of the JMT suite.
jmt.common.exception
Exceptions shared by the JMT engine, such as the load exception raised when a closed workload exceeds the capacity of the network.
jmt.jmch.distributions
Distribution support of the JMCH wizard.
jmva.eval
Expression evaluator of the JMVA wizard, used to enter service times and demands as expressions of model parameters.
jmva.link
Link between the JMVA GUI and the model data structures of the JSIM graph editor.
random
Random number generation for the JSIM simulation engine.
random.discrete
Discrete probability distributions for the JSIM simulation engine (Bernoulli, binomial, geometric, Poisson, uniform, ...).
simEngine
Core of the JSIM discrete event simulation engine: the simulation system, entities, events, predicates and event queues on which all JMT simulation tools rely.
solvers.dispatchers
Solver dispatchers of JMVA, which select and drive the appropriate exact or approximate solution algorithm for the model under study.
solvers.dispatchers.wrappers
Wrapper solvers used by the JMVA dispatchers.
solvers.priority
Priority support of the JMVA solvers: Priority MVA (P-MVA) and Related Workload Approximation (RWA) calculators for models with priority classes.
